name: MajlisAlpha UAE Macro & Rates Radar
purpose: Track UAE macro and rates drivers so company answers can connect source-backed issuer evidence to rates, oil, AED/USD peg context, real estate liquidity, bank funding, inflation pressure, and government spending.
macroPolicy: No macro read-through should be used in a brief unless driver, date, source route, affected tickers, assumption impact, owner, and reviewer status are captured.
workflow: capture macro driver from official or issuer-backed source
classify driver type and observation date
record valuation, margin, funding, liquidity, or risk impact
route material driver to peer, portfolio, quality, catalyst, or claim-trace workflow
mark macro read-through usable only after reviewer approval

escalationRules.condition: rates or funding driver changes bank, property, or discount-rate language
escalationRules.action: route to Answer Quality Lab and Peer Benchmark Matrix

escalationRules.condition: oil, fiscal, or project-spending driver changes sector outlook
escalationRules.action: send to Catalyst Calendar and Portfolio Risk Radar

escalationRules.condition: macro driver is unsupported by source URL, date, or evidence snippet
escalationRules.action: mark blocked and assign Source Refresh Scheduler owner

escalationRules.condition: macro driver changes a customer-facing claim or valuation scenario
escalationRules.action: open Claim Trace Inspector review before export

launchGate.readyRule: Macro & Rates Radar is pilot-ready when every material macro driver has driver type, source route, official URL, observation date, affected tickers, assumption impact, owner, and reviewer status.
launchGate.blockedRule: If a macro read-through is missing source path, date, affected ticker mapping, or assumption impact, it cannot support an exported brief.
